{{Quote|Where ''is'' he? Where is ''Vul Isen?!'' The Butcher of Dac! Where is he?|Cade Skywalker, while on Daluuj|<ref name="Legacy 48" />}}
In [[138 ABY]], during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]], the crew of the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]] [[Mynock (Helot-class)|''Mynock'']] undertook a '''mission''' to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Daluuj/Legends|Daluuj]], where they hoped to find and [[Assassin/Legends|kill]] the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Vul Isen]]. [[Cade Skywalker]]&mdash;a former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and the current [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the ''Mynock''&mdash;had recently begun a personal crusade against the [[One Sith|Sith]], and Isen became his first target after the scientist [[Final Protocol|poisoned]] the [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] of the planet [[Dac/Legends|Dac]]. Acting on some purchased intelligence, the crew traveled to [[Vul Isen's laboratory|Isen's laboratory]] on Daluuj.

After landing on-world, the ''Mynock''{{'s}} [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]], [[Deliah Blue]]; co-[[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Jariah Syn]]; and [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] stormed the [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratory]], where they [[Lightfight|killed]] a group of [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] but found no sign of their quarry. As Syn planted [[Time/Legends|timed]] explosives, Skywalker and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Wolf Sazen]] defeated a group of Sith in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]] on a nearby bridge. Skywalker demanded that his last surviving [[Unidentified horn-row Sith Lord|opponent]] reveal the whereabouts of the "Butcher of Dac" but learned only that Isen was no longer on Daluuj. He thus left his [[Cho mok/Legends|maimed]] opponent to [[Death/Legends|die]] as the entire crew rushed to their ship and lifted off in time to escape from the exploding laboratory.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|I now know what I am. Not Jedi. Not Sith. I am what the Force has made me&hellip; The Sith's worst nightmare. Time to make war.|Cade Skywalker, on Wayland|<ref name="Legacy 46" />}}
In late<ref name="Extremes Trade" /> [[137 ABY]], during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]], the former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Cade Skywalker]]&mdash;who had recently become the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] [[Mynock (Helot-class)|''Mynock'']]&mdash;was [[Wayland trap|manipulated]] by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lady]] [[Darth Maladi]] into traveling to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]]. There, Maladi kidnapped the ''Mynock''{{'s}} [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]], [[Deliah Blue]], and implanted [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Yorik coral|coral]] [[Vongspawn|growths]] onto her back.<ref name="Legacy 45">[[Legacy (2006) 45|''Legacy'' (2006) 45]]</ref> Skywalker's former [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], [[Wolf Sazen]], was also on-world, having been led by [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to the side of his one-[[Time/Legends|time]] [[Padawan/Legends|student]]. After Skywalker mentally attacked Maladi with the Force and sent her fleeing, Sazen convinced him to [[Force healing/Legends|heal]] Blue's sickness using the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side of the Force]] rather than the [[dark transfer]] healing power that he traditionally called upon. Curing Blue caused Skywalker to reject the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]], and he afterward vowed to wage war against the [[One Sith]].<ref name="Legacy 46" />

Around the same time, [[Vul Isen]]&mdash;a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] in the service of [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Empire]]&mdash;[[Final Protocol|poisoned]] the [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] of the planet [[Dac/Legends|Dac]]. His [[viral spore]]s [[Speciecide|killed]] every living being on the [[Water/Legends|water]] world who was not [[Evacuation of Dac|evacuated]] in time by the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]].<ref name="Legacy 47" /> When Skywalker learned of the event, he deduced that [[Death/Legends|killing]] Isen would deal the Sith a severe blow, and the "Butcher of Dac" became the first target of his crusade. With Sazen as their newest member, the crew of the ''Mynock'' purchased intelligence from the [[Sakiyan/Legends|Sakiyan]] [[Naxy Screeger]] that indicated Isen was on the planet [[Daluuj/Legends|Daluuj]].<ref name="Legacy 48" />

==The mission==
{{Quote|I only face my enemies ''once.''<nowiki></nowiki>|Cade Skywalker, after leaving his Sith opponent to die|<ref name="Legacy 48" />}}
[[File:Escapefromdaluuj.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The crew of the ''Mynock'' flees from Vul Isen's laboratory after setting timed explosives inside.]]
Early in [[138 ABY]],<ref name="Extremes Trade" /> the ''Mynock'' landed on Daluuj outside of [[Vul Isen's laboratory|Isen's laboratory]], and Deliah Blue, along with Skywalker's co-[[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], [[Jariah Syn]], and [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], stormed the building. Although Isen was not there, they encountered a group of Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], who subsequently fell to the might of their [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]]. After the [[lightfight]] concluded, Blue stood guard as R2-D2 [[Slicer/Legends|sliced]] into the laboratory's [[Computer/Legends|computer]] system, while Syn planted timed explosives. Meanwhile, Skywalker and Sazen engaged a group of Sith in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]] on a bridge adjacent to the laboratory. As their foes fell to their [[Lightsaber/Legends|blades]], Skywalker demanded that the Sith tell him where Isen had gone.<ref name="Legacy 48" />

Eventually, a [[Unidentified horn-row Sith Lord|lone Sith]] remained, and he exchanged taunts with Skywalker as they [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|dueled]]. The former Jedi was able to [[Cho mok/Legends|sever]] the Sith's [[Limb/Legends|legs]] at the knee, and with his opponent at his mercy, Skywalker promised to spare his life if he disclosed the whereabouts of both Isen and the scientist's planet-killing [[Poison/Legends|toxins]]. The Sith revealed only that Isen had previously used Daluuj as a base and had left none of his secrets behind. Syn then [[Comlink/Legends|contacted]] Skywalker and informed him that the explosives had been set, and, having obtained no useful information, Skywalker left his protesting opponent to die as he and Sazen rushed to their ship. The entire crew boarded the ''Mynock'' and got the vessel airborne shortly before the base and the bridge exploded.<ref name="Legacy 48" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Got a direction for us to go yet, or should we just continue flying 'somewhere'?''"<br />"''I don't know! I can't figure out how to get ''ahead'' of Isen&hellip;|Jariah Syn and Cade Skywalker plot their next move|<ref name="Legacy 48" />}}
The ''Mynock'' departed Daluuj, and its crew found themselves without any leads in their hunt for Isen. However, the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Jool]] soon contacted them and insisted that they come immediately to the planet [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]. They obliged their old friend's request,<ref name="Legacy 48" /> and upon arriving Skywalker met with Jool and [[Vedo Anjiliac Atirue]], from whom he learned that Isen had also [[Devastation of Da Soocha|poisoned]] the Hutt [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Da Soocha]]. Additionally, Vedo's nephew [[Azzim Anjiliac Atirue|Azzim]] had been killed in an Imperial [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]] of the planet [[Napdu]]. In response, the Hutts had set into motion a plan to lure Isen to the planet [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]], and they hired Skywalker to follow the scientist there and [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] him. The ''Mynock'' made its way to Utapau,<ref name="Legacy 49" /> where a final [[Mission to Utapau (Second Imperial Civil War)|showdown]] with Isen awaited Skywalker.<ref name="Legacy 50">[[Legacy (2006) 50|''Legacy'' (2006) 50]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The crew of the ''Mynock''{{'s}} mission to Daluuj appears in the [[Legacy (2006) 48|forty-eighth issue]] of the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]''. The issue was written by [[John Ostrander]], penciled by [[Jan Duursema]], and released by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="Legacy 48" /> on [[May 26]], [[2010]].<ref name="DarkHorse">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/16-989/Star-Wars-Legacy-48---Extremes-Part-1|text=Star Wars: Legacy #48 - Extremes (Part 1)}}</ref>
